title: Envelope Ru Translate
description: Russian translation of the envelope mod.
body:
Russian Translation for Envelope Mod

This resource pack provides a full and accurate Russian translation for the **Envelope** mod – a postal delivery mod for Minecraft that adds pigeons, mailboxes, packages, and a delivery system with payback mechanics.

**This pack is compatible with Envelope version 0.6.0 only.**

---

📦 What's included?

- ✅ Full translation of all blocks, items, and entities  
- ✅ Complete GUI translation (mailbox menus, address tags, payback tags, delivery logs)  
- ✅ All configuration options translated into Russian  
- ✅ Delivery status messages (e.g., "Recipient Not Found", "Inbox Full", "Payback Expired")  
- ✅ Courier Death Notices (with multiple variants)  
- ✅ Broadcast Reports  
- ✅ Subtitles and sounds (paper crackling, pigeon cooing, etc.)  
- ✅ JEI integration category  

---

🕊️ About the Envelope Mod

The Envelope mod adds a fully functional pigeon postal system to Minecraft. You can:

- Write letters with a quill  
- Fold and seal them with a stamp  
- Send them to other players, blocks, or service addresses  
- Receive packages and payback requests  
- Breed and manage pigeons  

This translation makes all of that fully playable in Russian.

---

⚠️ Important notice

**This resource pack will NOT receive any future updates.**

The Russian translation has been officially integrated into the Envelope mod by the author starting from version 0.6.1 and above. I am now collaborating directly with the mod author (`mortuusars`) to include all translations inside the mod itself.

Therefore, this pack is **archived** and remains available only for Envelope version 0.6.0.

For newer versions of the mod, simply download the latest Envelope release — the Russian translation will be included automatically.

---

Enjoy the game in Russian! 🐦📬
